Hi, I'm Tin — a graduate student at Monash University studying data science and analytics, with a particular interest in forecasting, risk, and turning messy data into a story people can actually act on.

Alongside my studies, I work in business development for [Tay Au Wine](https://tayauwine.vn), a Vietnamese wine import business, where I get to apply the same data skills to real commercial decisions — from landed-cost modelling to import partnership strategy.

This blog is where I practice the other half of the job: explaining what the data means, clearly, to people who weren't in the room when the analysis happened. When I'm not staring at a screen, you'll usually find me trekking somewhere in the Dandenong Ranges.
